limitations: Only first/middle/last were inspected at native resolution; remaining views were visually reviewed at 192x192 thumbnail resolution. Full file decode/numeric geometry checks are separate producer/validator evidence.
Flat face normals produce visible mild faceting/shading bands; materials are constant per part and do not establish realistic appearance.
No cast/contact shadows, texture, specular detail or ambient occlusion is established by these images.
High-elevation views partially hide the stem by ordinary projected overlap; this is not evidence that all surface regions are visible.
All source geometry was previously exposed and TEST is now visually inspected for integrity, so these views are not blind research evidence.
This visual GO does not resolve the documented official-renderer half-pixel principal-point mismatch or supply a trained reconstruction.
